decisionLog.decision: Keep Audralia as world authority, H-Earth as its ground-view occurrence, and Characters as a narrative room in the same Gratitude geography.
decisionLog.reason: This preserves estate identity without flattening distinct presentation modes.

decisionLog.decision: Do not choose snapshot transfer 50991d... or current transfer a67a4e... as final canonical geography in this audit.
decisionLog.reason: They diverge materially, the current convergence validator fails, and H-Earth registry preflight stops.

decisionLog.decision: Require all three product runtimes to consume one separately admitted, exact-blob canonical geography source through environment-specific adapters.
decisionLog.reason: Same-place continuity requires one position/topology truth but does not require one renderer.

decisionLog.decision: Preserve Characters lighting, water, moon, narrative state, and travel grammar while changing only its lawful geometry source in Step 9.
decisionLog.reason: Ambiance and interaction are accepted baseline qualities; independent terrain equations are not.

decisionLog.decision: Treat the three Characters-only destinations as derived local witnesses pending shared-adapter resolution.
decisionLog.reason: They may enrich the local room but may not create continental authority.

decisionLog.decision: Separate source, executable contract, public availability, browser capability, Page Excellence, and owner visual acceptance evidence.
decisionLog.reason: No one evidence class can stand in for the others.

decisionLog.decision: Stop before product construction, merge, deployment, or publication.
decisionLog.reason: This operation authorizes Steps 1-8 documentation only and critical authority blockers remain.

frozenConstructionSpecification.objective: Make Audralia planetary view, H-Earth ground view, and Characters moonlit Gratitude Coast resolve the same canonical place while preserving each room's renderer, ambiance, interaction grammar, and authority boundary.
entryPreconditions: A new governed construction operation is admitted against then-current public head with exact product paths.
Audralia/H-Earth authority selects one exact canonical geography source blob or an admitted successor; this audit does not select it.
H-Earth automatic registry preflight returns PASS for every proposed H-Earth path and mutationMayProceed is true under separate authority.
Audralia geographic convergence, coordinate reconciliation, and Mirror Manor reconciliation execute without crash and return PASS.
The H-Earth public route is reachable or a separately admitted route repair is included and independently qualified.
Protected Characters baseline blobs and H-Earth source-video anchor remain fetchable before construction.
constructionShape: Create one immutable geography-source binding that pins the selected canonical blob and exposes shoreline, terrain, hydrology, formation, landmark, map, camera-target, and LOD queries.
Bind the Audralia public map to that source without changing accepted camera, weather, cloud, loading, soundtrack, or interaction semantics unless separately authorized.
Bind H-Earth ground view to the same geography source while preserving its world-manifold and representation-transition laws.
Replace Characters runtime-local COAST, shorelineZ, terrainHeight, and duplicated shared-site coordinates with adapter queries or generated immutable buffers from the selected source.
Add Auren, Jeeves, and Beyond the Manor as derived local landmark records referenced to the same frame; keep finalContinentalAuthorityCreated false.
Preserve Characters moonlit shader/material language, story content, discovery rules, camera journey, exact return, and reduced-motion path.
Keep map, H-Earth, and Characters renderer implementations distinct; only geographic state and semantic landmark identity are shared.
qualificationMatrix: Executable geography, manifold, coordinate, Mirror Manor, map, scene, and reduced-motion contracts
Desktop WebGL2 public-route journey for all three environments
Phone-size WebGL2 public-route journey for all three environments
Reduced-motion semantic journey for Characters and all cross-room transitions
Side-by-side planetary, ground, and moonlit landmark witness captures at the eight shared sites
Page Excellence Architecture PASS for every mutated route
Independent public fetchback after immutable candidate publication
Owner visual acceptance against the protected Characters baseline and H-Earth experience-anchor video
stopConditions: Any proposed source is not selected by the appropriate Audralia/H-Earth authority.
Any H-Earth registry result is STOP or mutationMayProceed is false.
Any protected baseline blob or video identity changes unexpectedly.
Any consumer retains or creates a second coastline, terrain, hydrology, or shared landmark coordinate authority.
Any executable reconciliation crashes or fails.
Any public route is unavailable, any required WebGL2 journey fails, or visual comparison cannot be completed.
Any Page Excellence or owner visual acceptance result is not PASS.
Public head moves without an admitted atomic successor transition.
